user_prompt: Find my biggest segment, then show me the 3 most-recently-added people in it.
judge_criteria: The answer identifies a specific segment as 'the biggest' (by name or by reasoning).
The answer then lists 3 profiles from inside that segment.
Each profile has at minimum an email or identifier so the user can recognize them.
The 3 profiles are the most-recently-added ones (newest joiners), not random members.
